title: /api/chat/audio streams chunked to EVERY toy whenever the TTS provider can stream — no negotiation, no kill switch
scenario: With AI:TtsProvider=elevenlabs, DependencyInjection.cs:209 registers ElevenLabsTtsSynthesisService which implements IStreamingAudioSynthesisService (ElevenLabsTtsSynthesisService.cs:47), so Chat() takes StreamTtsPassThroughAsync unconditionally: HTTP 200, no Content-Length. The firmware online loop reads /api/chat/audio via read_response_into() (voice_client.cpp:817-863) which rejects getSize()<=0 (752-757) → failure clip on the first turn of every online session, while the backend already persisted the turn and cost. StoryQaController guards this with X-Areg-Accept-Stream + StoryQa:StreamAnswerAudio; the chat path has neither.
fix: Stream only when X-Areg-Accept-Stream==1 and a config switch is on; else buffered SynthesizeArmenianAsync.

title: Parent mode toggle ignored mid-session (duplicate of A6)
scenario: Mid-game turn with no keyword → gate ModeDetector None → ChatService promotes None to ActiveModes entry and continues; ChatService never consults mode flags.
fix: Gate on the active mode when detectedMode==None.

title: Negotiated streaming can return HTTP 200 with zero bytes; toy goes silent instead of the failure clip
scenario: StatusCode=200 set at 686 before the first ReadAsync; provider resets on the first body read → catch at 712 returns EmptyResult → 200 + empty chunked body; a 0-byte stream still gets pause+bridge+recap appended (699-706).
fix: First ReadAsync before touching the response; on failure while !Response.HasStarted return SpokenFailureResultAsync.

title: OffsetToSegment prefers the OpenAI cache render's byte map once any toy streamed the story over Wi-Fi
scenario: Cache map first, shipped map second; the cache + .segments.json are written by StoryAudioController on any Wi-Fi stream; afterwards every SD child's barge-in offset for that story maps against the wrong MP3 → wrong scene grounding and recap.
fix: Prefer the shipped map (production path); firmware could send src=sd|stream.

title: Reflection answer skips SelfHarmSignal and SecrecyPromiseGuard
scenario: Child answers «chem uzum aprel» after a story; only moderation runs (17% recall measured); on a miss the model reacts warmly, rows stored Clean.
fix: SelfHarmSignal.IsPresent(answer) || moderation self-harm → speak SelfHarmSignal.Response, Blocked/Flagged; SecrecyPromiseGuard on the reaction.

title: last=false with an empty/blocked answer still speaks the goodbye close
scenario: Latent: shipped firmware always sends last=true (AregVoiceMvp.ino:740-743); contract at 976-981 wrong for a multi-question loop.

title: Voice chat mode gate ignores the per-child override (duplicate of A5)
scenario: Device Game=off, child override on: voice-intent (default child resolved) says game, toy opens the loop, first /api/chat/audio turn refused.
fix: Resolve the default child once and pass its Id at both sites.

title: Failed turns are never metered: STT/GPT spend on transient_failure paths bypasses the cap
scenario: Every transient_failure return (313, 471, 578; 889, 1023) exits before the cost block; AudioChatController returns 502 before its cost block; during a TTS outage every turn pays STT+GPT and the cap never advances.
fix: Record the already-spent estimate in each failure branch.

title: story-qa and reflection-answer carry no chat rate limiter
scenario: StoryQaController has no [EnableRateLimiting(ChatRateLimiter.PolicyName)]; a button-bounce loop fires dozens of STT+GPT+TTS turns per minute until the cap trips.
evidence: grep EnableRateLimiting → ChatController.cs:16, AudioChatController.cs:23, DeviceController.cs:235 only; Program.cs:238-242 attribute-only policies

title: Heartbeat stores six firmware/content strings unbounded
scenario: Only ContentSyncStatus/Error/ResetReason are normalised (274-279); a multi-MB contentStories lands on the Device row and every list/backup.

title: Game honesty bound not enforced server-side: who-first accepts outcome won/lost
scenario: AllowedOutcomes applies to every game key; only firmware nulls who-first; a regression or key holder reports who-first won → dashboard claims a physical fact the toy cannot sense.

title: Dev-harness gate exact-matches the path; a trailing slash reaches model binding outside Development
scenario: POST /api/story-qa-text/ skips the middleware (PathString.Equals) → 400 on a malformed body before the controller's 404 → existence leak.
fix: StartsWithSegments or trim the trailing slash.

title: Variant-ending playback asks Q&A with the base story id and offsets (latent, flag off)
scenario: With AREG_VARIANT_ENDINGS_ENABLED=1 the toy plays -alt.mp3 but sends the base id; grounding and byte map are the base's.
fix: Defer until the flag ships; firmware sends variant=1.
